name: oh-my-octos
author: octos-org
description: Curated defaults for Octos as a coding agent: work discipline prompt, deterministic edit checks, project-instruction injection, session budget guard.

discovery.summary: Work discipline rules plus deterministic hooks (edit syntax checks, AGENTS.md injection, session budget guard). No tools to call; read prompts/discipline.md for the rules. Optional packs are one command each and are listed in README.md under 'Optional packs' (e.g. slides/PPT: `octos skills install mofa-org/mofa-skills/mofa-slides`); suggest the exact command when the user asks for a capability that is not installed.
